name: void_bolt_flight
notes: A hole in the world: a pure-black core (14 px) in a ragged, crackling violet corona with a white-hot crescent whipping round it; broken lens arcs close in on it each half-loop and violet streaks, motes and grit are SUCKED in from behind and around (nothing trails out). Violets from the stalker's own body. Anchor = core centre. 8 frames @12 fps. px_per_m from the idle frame (crouched pose, 179 px / 2.6 m).
